neighbours.label: the function word that links a physics or electronics term to its definition (degree of freedom, component that limits, circuit in which the)
fire: A rigid body moving in space has six degrees of freedom.
An inductor is a passive component that resists changes in current.
The ohm is the resistance of a conductor in which the current is one ampere.
A diode is a semiconductor device that allows current in one direction.
Each rotational degree of freedom stores energy at high temperature.
Momentum is a conserved quantity that describes the motion of a body.
A transformer is an electrical device that changes the voltage of a current.
Entropy measures the number of microstates of a system.
quiet: A large family moving house has six boxes of books.
An apron is a simple garment that protects your clothes.
The hall is the room of the house in which the guests wait.
A ladder is a wooden tool that lets you reach high shelves.
Each summer the garden stores water in a large barrel.
Patience is a valued quality that describes a good teacher.
A blender is a kitchen device that mixes fruit into juice.
A census measures the number of residents of a town.
